ux.premise: Get to D.C. with your health, sanity, and dignity intact. The road has other plans.
ux.classic_desc: Broken systems. Dubious advice. A fighting chance. The original trail, with plenty of political absurdity.
ux.deep_desc: La même route, une réalité plus sombre. Une satire plus noire sur les attaques contre les droits des personnes trans, les restrictions à l’avortement, les abus de surveillance, la détention et les refus de soins. Choisissez ce parcours si vous souhaitez aborder ces thèmes.
ux.code_help: The same code and choices replay the same journey. CL is Classic; DP is The Deep End.
ux.code_error: Enter a valid CL- or DP- run code ending in two digits.
ux.onboarding: Check your supplies and conditions, then travel one day. Choices show known effects; the next screen explains what actually changed.
ux.prepare_help: Buy what you need, keep an eye on your budget, and review your load before leaving.
ux.store_error: The store could not load. Return to the title and try again.
ux.resolve_first: Réglez la situation actuelle avant de reprendre la route.
ux.save_error: Your journey could not be saved on this device.
ux.camp_hint: Opening camp costs nothing. Recovery and repairs use the resources and time shown below.
ux.repair_help: Choose a repair and review its cost before fitting a part or calling for help.
ux.camp_cooldown: An action is unavailable while its recovery cooldown is active.
ux.rested: A little rest. The country will still be broken in the morning.
ux.boss_hint: The filibuster resolves in one action. Endure the debate, then learn the result of the vote.
ux.boss_resolution: The debate ends early if sanity reaches zero. Otherwise, a final vote decides your run.

beltway_briefing.name: Department of Renaming Things
beltway_briefing.desc: The meeting hall has a patriotic new name. Your form uses the old one; the amendments use both. The clerk identifies the building by pointing through the window.
beltway_briefing.choice_0: Read everything; use a snack pack
beltway_briefing.log_0: Snacks gone, instructions matched and saved. You've traced the hall all the way across the street.
beltway_briefing.log_1: Two corrections missed. You confidently prepare to visit the building formerly known as the building.
beltway_briefing.log_2: You miss a cross-reference. Six people, six answers. The form has successfully created a committee.

classic_bridge_crews.name: The Efficiency Emergency
classic_bridge_crews.desc: The council lists five accomplishments from firing the bridge crew. All five mean “fired the bridge crew.” The bridge is closed; former workers need help hauling detour signs.
classic_bridge_crews.choice_0: Donate one pack; haul barrier signs
classic_bridge_crews.log_0: Supplies donated, arms aching. You haul the signs without once calling yourselves job creators.
classic_bridge_crews.log_1: You file the dated photo. It shows exactly how much traffic “efficiency” can carry: none.

deep_secure_line.name: Private Chat, Public Application
deep_secure_line.desc: The motel manager wants job applications in a chat with his vending-machine guy. ‘It’s encrypted,’ he says. Excellent. Only authorized strangers can read your address.
deep_secure_line.choice_0: Check the roster; document the problem
deep_secure_line.log_0: You record stray contacts without private details. The vending-machine guy confirms he is not HR.
deep_secure_line.log_1: ‘Totally private,’ you tell everyone. A former employee replies, ‘I quit during the Obama administration.’
deep_secure_line.log_2: He lists who may see applications. The housekeeper crosses out ‘everyone in the chat.’ One more mess management expects her to clean.

raw_milk.name: Corporate Says It’s Healthy
raw_milk.desc: A wellness booth offers free raw milk, wrapped snacks, and MAHA-themed ‘bodily freedom.’ The attendant has a script, research links, and corporate instructions on the correct angle of her smile.
raw_milk.log_0: Your stomach begins its own review. The next exit becomes the only policy issue that matters.
raw_milk.log_1: The cited study isn’t about milk. You show the attendant. Corporate’s science joins the recycling.
raw_milk.log_2: You stash the snacks. Their ingredients list fits on the wrapper without a presidential commission.

tariff_whiplash.name: Tariff Whiplash
tariff_whiplash.desc: A new tariff list demands extra spares for your signed parts trade. Corporate’s “Remain Positive” email supplies the clerk’s script: “Unfortunately, unfortunately, unfortunately.”
tariff_whiplash.choice_0: Check terms; trade two supply packs
tariff_whiplash.log_0: Two packs gone; surcharge documented. Your signature apparently approved whatever number came next.
tariff_whiplash.choice_1: Claim the extra pack was included
tariff_whiplash.log_1: You get the extra pack and lose the benefit of the doubt. Management material.
tariff_whiplash.choice_2: Compare slips; offer one supply pack
tariff_whiplash.log_2: One pack accepted, corrected terms saved. Corporate's positive-attitude email survives every revision.

classic_civic_potluck.desc: The notice canceling the federal food fund is taped beside the stew. 'Printouts go under the bowls,' says the cook. 'That's the federal contribution.'
classic_civic_potluck.log_0: You eat and pack three bundles. Somebody offers seconds without checking whether you're a corporation.
classic_civic_potluck.choice_1: Pack two bundles; share their story
classic_civic_potluck.log_1: You promise to mention the cooks in Washington. They label the leftovers 'evidence.'
classic_civic_potluck.log_2: Your beans join the pantry. The cook offers naming rights to one very unimpressed potato.
classic_civic_potluck.name: Civic Center Potluck

classic_crossing_block_party.desc: After the order to cut federal library support, librarians stage a cookout: free books, free seating. 'I know,' one says. 'This is how empires fall.'
classic_crossing_block_party.choice_0: Give one food bundle; help grill
classic_crossing_block_party.log_0: You grill while a librarian reads horror aloud. The horror is next year's budget.
classic_crossing_block_party.log_1: 'I shouldn't need a muffin mortgage to sit down.' The café workers in line howl.
classic_crossing_block_party.choice_2: Share two water and towel bundles
classic_crossing_block_party.log_2: You pass out cold towels. The librarian saves one for the next official who works up a sweat attacking free books.
classic_crossing_block_party.name: Crossing Block Party

classic_freeway_mural.desc: Artists under an overpass named for a billionaire are painting his cleaner. They need help, water and a group photo. His contribution to the portrait is the muddy footprint she’s scrubbing.
classic_freeway_mural.log_0: Arms aching, you finish a coat. The billionaire's sign contributes its usual share of the labor.
classic_freeway_mural.log_1: Your contribution fits in the photo without its own dedication plaque.
classic_freeway_mural.log_2: All six of you squeeze into the photo. The billionaire’s name stays above everyone’s head. Even the overpass has an org chart.
classic_freeway_mural.name: Freeway Mural Crew

classic_mail_drop.desc: A volunteer brings letters mocking Washington’s five-accomplishment demand, a road pack, and a request to record yours. One retiree lists ‘fed the cat’ twice. The cat requests a third.
classic_mail_drop.log_0: You save the letters, laughing. The cat's performance-management system is just as arbitrary, but considerably fluffier.
classic_mail_drop.log_1: Update recorded, road pack collected. Your next five accomplishments will be performed with your mouth full.
classic_mail_drop.choice_2: Sort urgent letters; share one pack
classic_mail_drop.log_2: One snack pack fuels sorting. Someone labels the empty wrapper “Employee of the Month.”
classic_mail_drop.name: Mail Drop Pickup

classic_media_training.desc: At a free protest workshop, a radio host rehearses questions about the cabinet’s Signal chat. She says ‘I don’t know’ is acceptable. Nobody from customer service believes her.
classic_media_training.name: Who Gets to Say ‘No Comment’?
classic_media_training.log_0: Transcript checked. Your answer survives a follow-up question without blaming the microphone.
classic_media_training.log_1: One does a flawless cabinet impression: talks for two minutes, answers nothing, requests a promotion.

classic_mutual_aid.desc: Three volunteers offer $10 and a food bundle for loading. Since the federal food-funding cuts, the folding table is the only one that hasn’t worked a double.
classic_mutual_aid.choice_0: Give two bundles; share their appeal
classic_mutual_aid.log_0: You film the food being unloaded. Your financial transparency report comes with dented cans.
classic_mutual_aid.choice_1: Load for $10 and one food bundle
classic_mutual_aid.log_1: Dinner, ten dollars, and a backache. Management is a folding chair. You prefer it.
classic_mutual_aid.choice_2: Give one bundle; post their wishlist
classic_mutual_aid.log_2: You share the wishlist. It contains beans, rice, and no exciting opportunities for private equity.
classic_mutual_aid.name: Pop-up Mutual Aid

classic_mutual_aid_dispatch.desc: Food-aid drivers borrow radios to coordinate deliveries after the federal food fund is canceled. Washington cut the money; the loading schedule still says 'ask Kevin.'
classic_mutual_aid_dispatch.choice_0: Deliver two food bundles in your van
classic_mutual_aid_dispatch.log_0: You make both drop-offs. Nobody commissions a feasibility study of the front steps.
classic_mutual_aid_dispatch.choice_1: Donate one bundle of radio batteries
classic_mutual_aid_dispatch.log_1: The radio crackles back. Kevin announces 'We have beans.' Something worth a national address.
classic_mutual_aid_dispatch.choice_2: Keep a copy of the needs tally
classic_mutual_aid_dispatch.log_2: You keep the tally for Washington. Kevin has listed every shortage. 'Nobody could have known' will have to explain page two.
classic_mutual_aid_dispatch.name: Mutual Aid Dispatch Center

classic_neighborhood_watch.desc: One street, three official names. Residents offer directions, public help numbers, and a road pack for moving their corrected map board. The pizza driver is touring the town’s entire patriotic history.
classic_neighborhood_watch.name: The Street Formerly Known as the Street
classic_neighborhood_watch.log_0: Numbers checked and saved. You can now ask “Where are we?” without first hearing about the mayor’s accomplishments.
classic_neighborhood_watch.choice_1: Move the board; correct the arrows
classic_neighborhood_watch.log_1: Sore arms, one road pack earned. The arrows point somewhere besides the mayor's achievements.
classic_neighborhood_watch.log_2: You find the exit. The crew celebrates like somebody's successfully canceled a subscription.

classic_overpass_stage.desc: An overpass troupe stages the federal library cuts. Their billionaire is a sock puppet. 'We tried a real billionaire,' the director says. 'Couldn't afford the subsidies.'
classic_overpass_stage.log_0: You post the show. The sock puppet has better comic timing and fewer conflicts of interest.
classic_overpass_stage.log_1: You question the puppet until hoarse. He demands security. The director shuts him in a sock drawer.
classic_overpass_stage.name: Overpass Pop-Up Stage

classic_press_briefing.desc: A reporter asks about Sharpiegate and bosses denying weather. You remember being told the roads were fine because the store was open. The register must control the jet stream.
classic_press_briefing.name: Forecast: Still Your Problem
classic_press_briefing.choice_0: Answer with the saved weather alerts
classic_press_briefing.log_0: You cross-check every date, exhausted. The storm had issued clearer instructions than your shift manager.
classic_press_briefing.choice_1: Send a short account while resting
classic_press_briefing.log_1: Feet up, you send two sentences. The passenger seat offers better accommodation than your old employer.
classic_press_briefing.choice_2: Record an interview; verify the dates
classic_press_briefing.log_2: You save the verified recording. The warning said ‘stay home.’ Payroll’s version had different weather.

classic_press_pool_qna.desc: A diner reporter asks to record your trip costs and mileage. You agree. The cabinet gave a journalist airstrike plans without even checking the guest list.
classic_press_pool_qna.name: An Interview, Between Refills
classic_press_pool_qna.choice_0: Answer with receipts on the table
classic_press_pool_qna.log_0: You check every total, exhausted. The reporter asks if you bought breakfast or the diner.
classic_press_pool_qna.log_1: Quick, painless, wrong. The reporter checks the map. Your estimate has driven farther than the van.
classic_press_pool_qna.choice_2: Let a crewmate talk; stretch out
classic_press_pool_qna.log_2: They take the questions. You become the first person in a political interview to lie down openly.

classic_radio_phonebank.desc: The college station needs spots opposing the federal library cuts. Eight dollars per recording. Your opinion has reached the market value of a sandwich.
classic_radio_phonebank.log_0: 'Free Wi-Fi scares billionaires,' you tell listeners. 'People might read the second half of the contract.'
classic_radio_phonebank.choice_1: Share one snack bundle; rehearse calls
classic_radio_phonebank.log_1: You pass out snacks and rehearse calls. The script contains fewer apologies than your work emails.
classic_radio_phonebank.log_2: You record the spot and pocket eight dollars. Your unpaid opinions are filing a grievance.
classic_radio_phonebank.name: College Radio Phonebank

classic_service_station.desc: The tariff quote has promoted replacement parts to luxury goods. A union mechanic and apprentices offer to fit your spares. “Congratulations. Your wipers are now an inheritance.”
classic_service_station.log_0: Your spares go in; you rest. The waiting-room chair delivers the recovery Washington advertised.
classic_service_station.log_1: The apprentices record the symptoms. The van receives more oversight than the tariff plan.
classic_service_station.log_2: Wipers fitted. You can see the road again. The economic outlook remains streaky.
classic_service_station.name: Service Station Handoff

classic_union_blockade.desc: Tariff uncertainty halved the shifts. The CEO's bonus somehow retained full-time hours. A steward offers space on the picket and a box of donated road snacks.
classic_union_blockade.log_0: You raise your signs. Management reports a troubling rise in employee engagement.
classic_union_blockade.log_1: The steward passes up a road pack. The outside agitators are now carrying snacks.
classic_union_blockade.log_2: You open the snacks. The picket's first shareholder meeting distributes actual crackers.
classic_union_blockade.name: Union Solidarity Blockade

classic_water_drive.desc: Drivers offer two supply bundles for unloading beneath Trump’s showerhead headline. 'He needs more pressure,' says a courier. 'My boss texts every time my GPS dot stops.'
classic_water_drive.log_0: Drivers refill their bottles. Your water policy has passed its first test: containing water.
classic_water_drive.log_1: Two bundles earned. Your arms object to being classified as critical infrastructure.
classic_water_drive.name: Water Drive Relay

deep_circuit_breaker.desc: Tariffs have hiked charger prices. Six phones share one overheating adapter. A repair volunteer checks your spares. “Too small to bail out. We’ll have to fix it.”
deep_circuit_breaker.name: One Socket, Six Phones
deep_circuit_breaker.log_0: The adapter gets replaced; you get a chair. Neither requires a Senate hearing.
deep_circuit_breaker.log_1: Your neck aches over the last charged phone. The other five enjoy tariff protection from electricity.
deep_circuit_breaker.choice_2: Use two repair packs; document costs
deep_circuit_breaker.log_2: Fix completed, price notice saved. At last, a rising percentage that isn’t on a price tag.

deep_field_intel.desc: Library volunteers hand you public records for Washington, with private details removed. Their security system is a folder labeled ‘PUBLIC.’ The cabinet should ask about the enterprise plan.
deep_field_intel.name: Carry This to Washington
deep_field_intel.log_0: Sources checked, folder packed. Washington’s homework rides on the floor. It didn’t chip in for gas.
deep_field_intel.log_1: Their private copies get separate folders marked ‘PRIVATE.’ The cabinet is welcome to steal this technology.
deep_field_intel.log_2: You catch a phone number in the public copy. One stroke of a pen; no press conference explaining how secure the pen is.

deep_grassroots_signal.desc: The rally has two addresses in your chat. To improve security after Signal, someone changes the icon to a padlock. Both addresses are now securely wrong.
deep_grassroots_signal.name: The Rally Address Has Entered the Chat
deep_grassroots_signal.choice_0: Check and share the organizer’s notice
deep_grassroots_signal.log_0: You confirm the address and send the dated link. The padlock gets promoted to decoration.
deep_grassroots_signal.log_1: You date the screenshots: wrong town, wrong year. Your phone now needs a cigarette.
deep_grassroots_signal.log_2: Your directions send a friend to an empty parking lot. Congratulations on organizing a deeply private rally.

deep_media_ambush.desc: At a free protest workshop, a volunteer hands out the Sharpiegate report, then plays Trump arguing with a forecast. Six workers recognize the problem: somebody gave the difficult customer nuclear weapons.
deep_media_ambush.name: Please Hold While We Check Reality
deep_media_ambush.log_0: Your answers match the report. Your patience runs out when ‘the president’ asks to speak to the weather’s manager.
deep_media_ambush.log_1: You rehearse ‘Show me where it says that.’ Nobody offers the imaginary president a refill.
deep_media_ambush.choice_2: Send remembered notes; take a nap
deep_media_ambush.log_2: Excellent nap. Incorrect summary. The report has your correction waiting when you wake, like a shift supervisor.

deep_memorandum_dump.desc: Residents offer cut notices beside DOGE's corrected contract figure. Eight billion became eight million. Their closed service desk has declined to reopen by typo.
deep_memorandum_dump.name: The Public Paper Pile
deep_memorandum_dump.choice_0: Sort and save the dated notices
deep_memorandum_dump.log_0: Head aching, you file the notices. “Savings” takes three folders; “service” fits under CLOSED.
deep_memorandum_dump.log_1: Copies mailed. Washington’s savings plan is now eating into your envelope stash.
deep_memorandum_dump.choice_2: Store the files; close the folder
deep_memorandum_dump.log_2: Files saved, folder closed. By DOGE standards, you’ve now eliminated all the paperwork.

deep_state_dirge.desc: The hearing on efficiency has spent an hour praising itself. Public comments get three minutes. A cleaner asks whether all that applause is on the clock.
deep_state_dirge.name: The Public Comment Endurance Test
deep_state_dirge.choice_0: Use one snack pack; stay and speak
deep_state_dirge.log_0: Snacks gone, patience gone, statement recorded. Your three minutes contain more verbs than the chair's hour.
deep_state_dirge.choice_1: Withdraw; walk back to the van
deep_state_dirge.log_1: You hike back, aching and unheard. The chair records another successful reduction in public complaints.
deep_state_dirge.log_2: You miss your turn but recover your patience. The chair thanks the empty microphone for keeping its comments brief.

deep_watch_party.desc: A community screening covers political pressure on weather forecasters. On-screen, nobody remembers who gave the order. The folding chair beneath you has accepted sole responsibility for your suffering.
deep_watch_party.name: Public Accountability, Folding Chairs
deep_watch_party.choice_0: Check the discussion against the investigation
deep_watch_party.log_0: The dates line up. The excuses don’t. Your headache has excellent supporting documentation.
deep_watch_party.log_1: You bookmark the discussion and escape the chair. Accountability can continue without conducting experiments on your tailbone.
deep_watch_party.choice_2: Share a recap from memory; get some sleep
deep_watch_party.log_2: You sleep through the correction to your forwarded claim. A perfect cabinet performance, minus the salary.

deep_watchdog_sync.desc: A retired bookkeeper checks DOGE’s billion-to-million correction. She counts six biscuits onto a plate. “Six thousand, if anyone from Washington asks.”
deep_watchdog_sync.name: Receipts at the Community Table
deep_watchdog_sync.choice_0: Use your paper; share checked examples
deep_watchdog_sync.log_0: Copies made, checked notes saved. The biscuit tin survives its audit without requiring a spokesperson.
deep_watchdog_sync.log_1: The totals finally add up. Somebody checks the calculator for a deep-state switch.
deep_watchdog_sync.log_2: Your total gets corrected. Congratulations: you've brought federal accounting standards to the neighborhood.

fundraiser_detour.desc: The fundraiser's corporate sponsor sent a six-foot logo. Nobody brought a pan big enough to cook it. Guests who can spare food are supplying dinner.
fundraiser_detour.log_0: You supply actual food. The organizer puts your names above the company that donated a JPEG.
fundraiser_detour.log_1: You skip the speeches. The engine makes fewer promises and is noticeably easier to interrupt.
fundraiser_detour.name: Fundraiser Detour

town_hall_drift.desc: At a housing meeting, a council member prescribes healthier choices using the MAHA report. A tenant asks whether her landlord counts as a parasite. He turns off her microphone.
town_hall_drift.name: Has Anyone Tried Paying the Rent?
town_hall_drift.choice_0: Wait your turn to read the rent figures
town_hall_drift.log_0: Standing wears you out. You read the posted rents aloud; he cuts the mic. The room is now officially affordable.
town_hall_drift.log_1: Your legs ache. A tenant suggests listing the council member on Airbnb: spacious, vacant, difficult to contact.
town_hall_drift.log_2: The quiet helps. Your ‘rents doubled’ claim fails a phone check. You try again, louder.

deep_waystation_boost.desc: Food-aid drivers offer their fastest shortcut for help with crates, or an easier route over coffee. 'Deliveries still have to arrive,' one says. 'Unlike the federal food money.'
deep_waystation_boost.choice_0: Stack crates; take the fastest shortcut
deep_waystation_boost.log_0: You move the crates and skip the jam. Six workers outmaneuver a planning committee without appointing one.
deep_waystation_boost.choice_1: Drink their coffee; take the easier route
deep_waystation_boost.log_1: Coffee improves the directions. The driver narrates the map like the van has acquired a sports commentator.
deep_waystation_boost.name: Heartland Waystation

deep_rustbelt_convoy.desc: Tariff paperwork has parked a line of trucks. Drivers offer a fast back-road group or the marked detour. Their cargo has traveled farther between inboxes.
deep_rustbelt_convoy.choice_0: Share a pack; follow the lead
deep_rustbelt_convoy.log_0: Snacks shared, miles gained. The trucker’s “Follow me” is the shortest trade policy you’ve heard all day.
deep_rustbelt_convoy.log_1: You signal and leave a gap. The trucker approves a trade agreement consisting entirely of waving.
deep_rustbelt_convoy.name: Rust Belt Convoy

deep_beltway_fastpass.desc: A “DOGE SAVINGS” banner hangs over a closed lane. Beneath it, a flagger offers a fast coned route or an easier merge. Both existed before the banner claimed credit.
deep_beltway_fastpass.name: The Flagger Knows the Way
deep_beltway_fastpass.choice_0: Take the coned route on signal
deep_beltway_fastpass.log_0: You gain miles. The flagger gets you moving with one hand. The banner requires two poles to stand there.
deep_beltway_fastpass.log_1: You merge smoothly. The back-seat transport committee is reduced to one satisfied grunt.

clinic_triage.desc: After a hot drive, a volunteer medic offers a free check and mentions low supplies. Across the street, a booth sells ‘freedom from modern medicine.’ The insurance industry calls that a deductible.
clinic_triage.name: No Subscription Required
clinic_triage.log_0: You declare everyone fine. Six worried people spend the next mile conducting a medical review by side-eye.
clinic_triage.choice_1: Use your water; get checked — 1 supply
clinic_triage.log_1: You drink your water and get checked. The bill is so absent you check under the chair.
clinic_triage.log_2: Bandages donated, shortages logged. The wellness banner covers twelve square feet and absolutely no wounds.

overnight_briefing.desc: It’s midnight outside the hearing hall. Your comment on five-accomplishment reports is stuck in a six-person fight over commas. The lot attendant offers to text when the doors open.
overnight_briefing.name: Five Accomplishments, Six Exhausted People
overnight_briefing.choice_0: Keep everyone awake; finish the notes
overnight_briefing.log_0: The notes grow longer. The van becomes an unpaid staff meeting with worse ventilation.
overnight_briefing.choice_1: Share one pack; take turns working
overnight_briefing.log_1: One supply pack buys rotating naps. Democracy runs on crackers and whoever's least asleep.
overnight_briefing.log_2: You sleep; your new ally texts when the doors open. The message ends before anyone asks for a campaign donation.

sat_straw_reserve.name: Emergency Straw Reserve
sat_straw_reserve.desc: Trump’s straw display blocks the water cooler. The cashier offers $10 to count boxes. ‘We’re free,’ she says, ‘to move this shit again.’
sat_straw_reserve.log_0: Six dollars for water, free straws. Washington would like credit for the affordable part.
sat_straw_reserve.log_1: Ten dollars earned. The manager asks for a second count. Freedom has a closing checklist.
sat_straw_reserve.log_2: You pass a 'WE LISTENED' banner. Six broke people try to look more like drinking utensils.

sat_corn_bullets.name: Five Things Corn Did Last Week
sat_corn_bullets.desc: The farmer copied Washington’s five-accomplishment emails. His worker offers you $8 to type four entries. The corn continues growing without submitting supporting documentation.
sat_corn_bullets.choice_0: Document the work the form omits
sat_corn_bullets.log_0: You save her approved account, cross-eyed. Management has converted photosynthesis into a clerical backlog.
sat_corn_bullets.log_1: You type her notes and pocket eight dollars. The corn has hired a ghostwriter.
sat_corn_bullets.log_2: You leave her filling boxes. Outside, the corn brazenly refuses to network.

sat_grant_groceries.name: Locally Grown Funding Gap
sat_grant_groceries.desc: The co-op offers twelve bucks to load crates. Since the federal food fund was canceled, the tomatoes have had to develop a fundraising strategy.
sat_grant_groceries.log_0: The co-op swaps contact details with you. Your beans have negotiated better connections than your résumé.
sat_grant_groceries.log_1: You load the crates and collect twelve dollars. Your back sends its invoice separately.
sat_grant_groceries.log_2: Back in the van, you discuss incorporating the beans. Maybe then somebody will bail them out.

sat_cow_citations.name: The Cow Hasn’t Read It Either
sat_cow_citations.desc: A dairy stand’s MAHA-style research links are dead. The cardboard cow smiles through it. Corporate has found a spokesperson who can’t request back pay.
sat_cow_citations.choice_0: Check titles; save the dead links
sat_cow_citations.log_0: You save the mismatches, squinting. The cow remains the only author you can locate.
sat_cow_citations.log_1: Five dollars. Two snack packs. The wrappers make no campaign promises.
sat_cow_citations.log_2: You leave hungry. The cardboard cow keeps smiling through lunch. Corporate has finally found its model employee.

sat_forecast_corrected.name: Optimism Will Not Dry Your Socks
sat_forecast_corrected.desc: A festival promoter covers a rain warning with a sun sticker. A worker points out the shelter. Trump needed a marker; this guy has outsourced meteorology to the craft aisle.
sat_forecast_corrected.log_0: You recover over a snack. Outside, the sun sticker makes its first contact with weather.
sat_forecast_corrected.choice_1: Trust the sign; reassure the crew
sat_forecast_corrected.log_1: You relax and announce clear skies. Then the first raindrop performs a hostile fact-check.
sat_forecast_corrected.log_2: You pass the fry stall. Nobody says ‘at least we saved money’ without a death stare.

sat_parking_gulf.name: Gulf of Parking Lot
sat_parking_gulf.desc: The owner renamed his puddle the Gulf of Premium Parking. He offers you $7 to repaint the sign. The attendant wanted a drain and received an ocean.
sat_parking_gulf.log_0: Seven dollars earned. The owner announces a waterfront upgrade. The attendant resumes asking for a drain.
sat_parking_gulf.choice_1: Check and mark the dry exit
sat_parking_gulf.log_1: You mark the dry exit. The owner's maritime empire ends at a correctly drawn arrow.
sat_parking_gulf.log_2: You leave the puddle undefeated. The van's cup holder remains your entire waterfront portfolio.

sat_library_minimum.name: The Minimum Viable Library
sat_library_minimum.desc: A librarian offers $9 for catalog checks while a federal form demands reading’s dollar value. She writes ‘more than this form.’ Invalid currency.
sat_library_minimum.log_0: The librarian gives you her contact card. Your crackers now qualify as a suspiciously effective public-private partnership.
sat_library_minimum.log_1: Nine dollars earned and a librarian's endorsement. Your eyes would like books to come in fewer letters.
sat_library_minimum.log_2: You pass the free-computer sign. Dangerous stuff. Somebody could look up what a union does.

sat_tariff_forklift.name: The Tariff Relabeling Shift
sat_tariff_forklift.desc: Another tariff update. The dispatcher offers fourteen dollars to move boxes, two supply packs to match labels. “We're bringing jobs back. From that pallet to this pallet.”
sat_tariff_forklift.log_0: Fourteen dollars earned. Your shoulders would like to offshore the next box.
sat_tariff_forklift.choice_1: Match labels for two supply packs
sat_tariff_forklift.log_1: Cross-eyed, you collect two road packs. You check whether lunch has also been amended.
sat_tariff_forklift.log_2: The boxes stay. So does the gas-money problem.

sat_alternator_tariff.name: The Patriotic Parts Counter
sat_alternator_tariff.desc: The TV says China pays the tariffs. The cashier turns the $12 card reader toward you.
sat_alternator_tariff.log_0: You buy the kit. China owes you a beer.
sat_alternator_tariff.log_1: She prints it. “For your reimbursement from China.”
sat_alternator_tariff.log_2: The kit stays on the shelf, awaiting payment from Beijing.

sat_billion_pothole.name: The Eight-Billion-Dollar Pothole
sat_billion_pothole.desc: DOGE listed an $8 million contract as $8 billion. A diner owner offers $10 to haul pothole patch. “I checked my math.”
sat_billion_pothole.log_0: You save both. A cashier has to explain a missing quarter. DOGE gets three spare zeroes.
sat_billion_pothole.log_1: You haul the bags and pocket $10. Your back would prefer DOGE’s math.
sat_billion_pothole.log_2: Finally, a problem you can solve by moving further left.

sat_bridge_bullets.name: Please Account for the Bridge
sat_bridge_bullets.desc: The bridge supervisor demands five accomplishments. The workers have listed every repair. Their report comes back: “More impact.” One points down at the river.
sat_bridge_bullets.choice_0: Type, check and save their report
sat_bridge_bullets.log_0: Report saved, eyes aching. “Kept the cars out of the river” is somehow the difficult part to explain.
sat_bridge_bullets.log_1: Your new ally submits “chewed” five times on the wrapper. Lunch now qualifies as more productive than bridge repair.
sat_bridge_bullets.log_2: You cross the bridge. Its workers are still explaining why that should count.

sat_press_pool_radio.name: Reply All, Clock Out
sat_press_pool_radio.desc: A café chat mixes lunch orders with staff messages. A customer asks whether ‘unpaid close’ comes with fries. The cashier offers eight dollars to sort the customer contacts from the staff.
sat_press_pool_radio.log_0: You show the owner. He creates separate chats and calls it a restructuring.
sat_press_pool_radio.log_1: Eight dollars. Forty-seven messages. The owner describes identifying three customers as ‘digital transformation.’
sat_press_pool_radio.log_2: You leave without eight dollars. The gas pump has no interest in your work-life balance.

sat_hydration_pressure.name: Hydration Sovereignty
sat_hydration_pressure.desc: The truck stop’s Trump showerhead promotion has soaked its LIMITED GOVERNMENT banner. The clerk offers $9 to hold the stand steady. Free showers require your own soap and considerably less patriotism.
sat_hydration_pressure.log_0: You emerge clean. The crew declines your suggestion of a ribbon-cutting for the armpits.
sat_hydration_pressure.log_1: Nine dollars and aching arms for holding the display upright. The clerk admires the design: 'Saved a fortune on the base.'
sat_hydration_pressure.log_2: You leave unwashed. The van's air freshener submits a resignation letter.

sat_museum_grant.name: The Exhibit of Pending Funds
sat_museum_grant.desc: The museum offers $11 to scan photos while it waits for federal funding. 'We exhibit starvation wages,' says the guide. 'We’re not supposed to demonstrate them.'
sat_museum_grant.log_0: You finish the scans and collect eleven dollars. The historical payroll is starting to look competitive.
sat_museum_grant.choice_1: Share one snack bundle; take tour
sat_museum_grant.log_1: The guide shares your snacks beside the company-store exhibit. Your employer's discount scheme suddenly looks less original.
sat_museum_grant.log_2: The exhibit ends at the eight-hour day. Your phone asks whether you'd like to work tonight.

sat_factcheck_shift.name: Click Here for Fifteen Dollars
sat_factcheck_shift.desc: An editor offers fifteen dollars to check MAHA’s citations. ‘Can you open a link?’ she asks. You finally encounter a job requirement the report’s authors could not meet.
sat_factcheck_shift.log_0: Fifteen dollars earned. Mismatches logged. Your eyes have put in for hazard pay.
sat_factcheck_shift.choice_1: Vouch for the studies by title
sat_factcheck_shift.log_1: Your cabinet impression gets a laugh. The editor opens a link: wrong paper. ‘Oh. You’re still doing the impression.’
sat_factcheck_shift.log_2: You decline. The fuel gauge immediately requests a meeting about your career choices.

sat_food_shelf.name: The Shelf Is Still Hungry
sat_food_shelf.desc: The federal food fund vanished. The forms reproduced. A co-op volunteer offers work: 'Backache pays in groceries. Headache pays cash.'
sat_food_shelf.choice_0: Pack bags for three food bundles
sat_food_shelf.log_0: Three bundles earned. Your shoulders would like their share delivered directly to a heating pad.
sat_food_shelf.log_1: Ten dollars for matching groceries to addresses. Add a subscription fee and a tech founder could announce he invented delivery.
sat_food_shelf.log_2: You keep driving. For dinner, the government recommends imagining how much worse socialism would taste.

sat_cabinet_guest.name: Manager Approval Required
sat_cabinet_guest.desc: A server on break scrolls through the cabinet’s leaked airstrike chat. “They invited a journalist. I need a manager’s PIN to refund ranch.”
sat_cabinet_guest.log_0: You save it. Apparently you’re cleared for airstrikes, just not dipping sauce.
sat_cabinet_guest.log_1: The crew laughs. You invent a detail, then defend it. Now you’re doing the whole administration.
sat_cabinet_guest.log_2: Two minutes for fries, then back to guarding the strategic ranch reserve.

sat_name_infrastructure.name: The Name Is the Infrastructure
sat_name_infrastructure.desc: The visitor desk’s $6 map shows a grandly renamed bridge, open to traffic. Outside, it’s closed. A clerk draws the detour by hand. The county has rebuilt the map.
sat_name_infrastructure.log_0: You keep it beside the closure notice. Six dollars for the county’s collectible alternate reality.
sat_name_infrastructure.log_1: You untangle the notices and save the route. The clerk christens your headache “Progress.” It continues hurting.
sat_name_infrastructure.choice_2: Leave and follow the posted detour
sat_name_infrastructure.log_2: You take the detour. The ribbon-cutting photo remains the shortest route across the river.

sat_straw_inspection.name: Strategic Straw Inspection
sat_straw_inspection.desc: A stand owner filming 'straw inspections' waves you into his video. His cashier says Trump's order covers federal purchasing. He requests fewer facts. She's still waiting for her break.
sat_straw_inspection.choice_0: Give cashier one snack; decline video
sat_straw_inspection.log_0: She eats your snack on camera. 'I'd like my break now.' His freedom documentary has accidentally acquired a labor demand.
sat_straw_inspection.choice_1: Read and save the actual order
sat_straw_inspection.log_1: You save the order and correct him on camera. He asks whether facts come in plastic.
sat_straw_inspection.log_2: He films another take. Your cup has received more scrutiny than a defense contract.

sat_shower_force.name: The National Shower Demonstration
sat_shower_force.desc: The Trump showerhead demonstration is flooding the sandwich stand. The manager offers twelve bucks to mop. Five buys a shower that hasn't annexed lunch.
sat_shower_force.log_0: You mop until your back aches and collect twelve dollars. The manager announces that the system is 'self-draining.'
sat_shower_force.log_1: You get clean for five dollars. The water stays in the shower. The manager calls this 'nothing special.'
sat_shower_force.log_2: The manager promises another demonstration. The cleaner begins moving sandwiches to higher ground.

sat_receipt_museum.name: The Museum of Very Large Savings
sat_receipt_museum.desc: A DOGE exhibit offers $13 to check labels against sources. Beside the billion-to-million correction sits a quarter labeled “One Trillion, Pending Review.”
sat_receipt_museum.log_0: Notes saved, head aching, $13 collected. Counting it twice fails to produce $26. You’re clearly unqualified for DOGE.
sat_receipt_museum.log_1: The crew laughs until you repeat the wrong figure. The curator adds you to the correction.
sat_receipt_museum.log_2: You leave the quarter's promotion ceremony. Your own net worth remains offensively well documented.

sat_transit_ribbon.name: The Ribbon-Cutting Holding Pattern
sat_transit_ribbon.desc: At a display about Chicago’s paused transit funds, organizers offer $9 to tally surveys. A cleaner eyes the ceremonial ribbon. ‘Try cutting my commute.’
sat_transit_ribbon.log_0: Volunteers add your number beside the survey hotline. Your contribution is listed under 'edible infrastructure.'
sat_transit_ribbon.log_1: Nine dollars and a headache. One nurse lists 'my manager's imagination' under alternative transportation.
sat_transit_ribbon.log_2: You drive away. The ribbon remains a zero-emissions vehicle with an exceptionally limited range.

sat_weather_desk.name: Six Dollars for Better Weather
sat_weather_desk.desc: A vendor offers six dollars to replace a rain warning with ‘Clear skies ahead.’ He cites Trump’s hurricane map. No forecasting experience required. Eyesight discouraged.
sat_weather_desk.choice_0: Save the sign and official forecast
sat_weather_desk.log_0: You document the mismatch until your eyes ache. The vendor asks whether facts require a permit.
sat_weather_desk.log_1: You pocket six dollars. A worker checks their forecast app. Your meteorology career ends at orientation.
sat_weather_desk.log_2: You keep your integrity. The gas pump regrets it does not participate in that rewards program.

sat_bibliography_emergency.name: This Reference Needs a Pulse
sat_bibliography_emergency.desc: The clinic offers $12 to check corrected MAHA references and treatment from your kit. “Washington makes a typo, I lose lunch,” says the receptionist.
sat_bibliography_emergency.log_0: Twelve dollars and a saved correction list. Your brain now displays ‘This page is not responding.’
sat_bibliography_emergency.choice_1: Accept care using your kit — 1 supply
sat_bibliography_emergency.log_1: The nurse uses your kit and you recover. She opens the bandages without making you choose a subscription tier.
sat_bibliography_emergency.log_2: The van’s second opinion is ‘probably fine.’ Opinions three through six have nothing to add.

west_grant_translation.name: Patriotic Thesaurus
west_grant_translation.desc: A coastal grant writer offers paid work translating the same public project into language that will survive Trump’s grant review. The sidewalk is now a freedom corridor. The shade tree is awaiting clearance.
west_grant_translation.log_0: You earn twelve dollars. The project is unchanged; its adjectives have passed inspection.
west_grant_translation.log_1: You preserve the original and the patriotic translation. The receipts need no translation.
west_grant_translation.log_2: The crew leaves the offer behind.

west_rail_replacement.name: High-Speed Replacement Van
west_rail_replacement.desc: After another Trump rail-funding fight, a contractor proposes replacing high-speed rail with vans and motivational language. Their ribbon-cutting team has transportation needs of its own.
west_rail_replacement.log_0: You collect fifteen dollars. Your van is now the most operational part of the announcement.
west_rail_replacement.log_1: A commuter joins your contacts. The brochure’s dotted line is still not a railway.
west_rail_replacement.log_2: The crew leaves the offer behind.

west_laboratory_overhead.name: A Building Is Overhead
west_laboratory_overhead.desc: A mountain-region laboratory is preparing for Trump’s proposed NIH overhead cap. The budget funds the experiment but objects to walls, power and refrigeration. A researcher offers you a practical choice.
west_laboratory_overhead.log_0: Fourteen dollars earned. You confirm the freezer is an essential scientific instrument, not a lifestyle choice.
west_laboratory_overhead.log_1: The research crew returns the favor with basic care and a new contact.
west_laboratory_overhead.log_2: The crew leaves the offer behind.

west_wind_loyalty.name: Wind Loyalty Hearing
west_wind_loyalty.desc: Following Trump’s order against wind and solar subsidies, a roadside energy fair is judging whether the breeze is sufficiently patriotic. A technician needs help that will actually keep equipment working.
west_wind_loyalty.log_0: Ten dollars earned. The wind keeps generating power without completing its loyalty questionnaire.
west_wind_loyalty.log_1: You gain a contact and an explanation involving actual electricity.
west_wind_loyalty.log_2: The crew leaves the offer behind.

west_desert_pressure.name: Desert Shower Freedom
west_desert_pressure.desc: A desert service stop celebrates Trump’s shower-pressure order with a demonstration nobody budgeted water for. The plumber offers to end the ceremony before the tank runs dry.
west_desert_pressure.log_0: You leave with water and a working understanding of the off switch.
west_desert_pressure.log_1: Twelve dollars earned. Working under the sink is less comfortable than announcing freedom above it.
west_desert_pressure.log_2: The crew leaves the offer behind.

west_beef_passports.name: America First, Argentina Next
west_beef_passports.desc: Trump’s idea to import more Argentine beef has reached a cattle-country loading yard. The ranchers are comparing the America First speeches with the import paperwork. The manifest needs a second pair of eyes.
west_beef_passports.log_0: Sixteen dollars earned. The cattle’s country of origin is clearer than the policy’s.
west_beef_passports.choice_1: Compare the speeches with the receipts
west_beef_passports.log_1: You add the contradiction to your evidence file. Nobody has yet asked the cows to apologize.
west_beef_passports.log_2: The crew leaves the offer behind.

ENC-C01-A.name: Un État plus petit
ENC-C01-A.desc: DOGE a licencié les équipes de nettoyage du parc. La garde forestière restante n’a pas déjeuné. Elle propose des gants à votre équipage devant des poubelles débordantes. « Félicitations. Le petit État, c’est vous. »
ENC-C01-A.choice_0: Partager de la nourriture et vider les poubelles
ENC-C01-A.log_0: Vous partagez votre déjeuner et transportez des sacs jusqu’à en avoir mal au dos. Elle vous tend un sac-poubelle. « Votre prime d’habillement. »
ENC-C01-A.choice_1: Photographier les dégâts pour votre dossier à Washington
ENC-C01-A.log_1: Vous photographiez les poubelles débordantes. Elle désigne les mouches. « Le seul service qui recrute encore. »
ENC-C01-A.fact: Cette scène tourne en dérision les suppressions de postes de février 2025 au National Park Service. La garde forestière et la rencontre sont fictives.

ENC-C01-B.name: Permission d’essorer
ENC-C01-B.desc: Dans un atelier de réparation coopératif au bord de la route, une personne vous montre la loi de l’Oregon limitant les verrous logiciels sur les pièces de rechange. Les bénévoles ont besoin de nourriture et d’aide pour récupérer des interrupteurs. Un lave-linge refuse une pièce qui fonctionne. Il accepte les sous-vêtements sales sans vérifier leur fabricant.
ENC-C01-B.choice_0: Partager de la nourriture ; récupérer des interrupteurs
ENC-C01-B.log_0: Vous partagez le déjeuner et démontez des interrupteurs jusqu’à avoir mal aux poignets. Le tambour peut tourner. L’autorisation du fabricant est toujours en cours de chargement.
ENC-C01-B.choice_1: Photographier le blocage et la loi de l’Oregon
ENC-C01-B.log_1: Vous conservez le message d’erreur et la règle de l’Oregon pour Washington. La pièce s’adapte parfaitement. C’est apparemment le fait d’être propriétaire qui pose un problème de compatibilité.
ENC-C01-B.fact: L’Oregon limite l’appairage des pièces lorsqu’il bloque des pièces de rechange fonctionnelles dans certains équipements grand public. La loi comporte des limites et des exceptions ; elle n’établit pas un droit à la réparation dans tout le pays. Cet atelier et ce lave-linge sont fictifs.

ENC-C01-C.name: La dignité au kilo
ENC-C01-C.desc: Rubio a ordonné le retour de Times New Roman dans les courriers du département d’État. Un atelier d’impression au bord de la route l’imite et jette ses tracts en Calibri avant le repas associatif. Les bénévoles ont besoin de nourriture et d’aide pour déplacer les bennes. La déchiqueteuse accepte les deux camps.
ENC-C01-C.choice_0: Partager de la nourriture ; déplacer les bennes
ENC-C01-C.log_0: Vous partagez le déjeuner et déplacez les bennes, le dos douloureux. Les tracts disent exactement la même chose. La diplomatie américaine a simplement décidé que les lettres avaient besoin de pieds.
ENC-C01-C.log_1: Vous photographiez les deux versions et l’ordre de Rubio. Toutes les phrases survivent. La dignité nationale repose apparemment sur de petites pattes sous l’alphabet.
ENC-C01-C.fact: Marco Rubio a ordonné le retour de Times New Roman dans les courriers du département d’État en décembre 2025. Cet ordre n’imposait aucun changement aux imprimeries privées ; celle de la scène est fictive.

ENC-C03-A.name: L’école en liquidation
ENC-C03-A.desc: Trump a ordonné de préparer la fermeture du département de l’Éducation. Lors d’une collecte scolaire, des parents demandent à votre équipage de nourrir les bénévoles ou de filmer leur fausse liquidation. Un bureau porte l’étiquette « LE POUVOIR RENDU AUX PARENTS ». Deux parents se disputent pour savoir comment le soulever.
ENC-C03-A.choice_0: Partager de la nourriture ; participer à la vente
ENC-C03-A.log_0: Vous partagez de la nourriture et participez aux fausses enchères des parents. Le bureau ira à la personne capable d’expliquer une division posée sans pleurer.
ENC-C03-A.choice_1: Filmer la mise en scène des parents
ENC-C03-A.log_1: Vous filmez la mise en scène pour Washington. Sous la chaise marquée « gestion locale », le schéma de montage fédéral est toujours collé.
ENC-C03-A.log_2: Vous laissez des provisions et vous installez dans le coin lecture. Le livre s’ouvre sans que personne ait dû supprimer sa maison d’édition.
ENC-C03-A.fact: Le décret de mars 2025 demandait des mesures visant à fermer le département de l’Éducation dans les limites permises par la loi. Il ne supprimait pas lui-même le département.

ENC-C03-B.name: L’aile au sec
ENC-C03-B.desc: Trump a annoncé une salle de bal à la Maison-Blanche financée par des donateurs, car les grands dîners nécessitaient des tentes. Dans un club associatif au bord de la route, les membres organisent une collecte sous un chapiteau qui fuit. Apportez de la nourriture et vous pourrez baptiser la grande aile nouvelle. C’est le coin au sec.
ENC-C03-B.choice_0: Partager de la nourriture ; baptiser la nouvelle aile
ENC-C03-B.log_0: Vous donnez de la nourriture et attribuez votre nom au coin sec. Quelqu’un y déplace une chaise pliante. Votre héritage présidentiel accueille une personne.
ENC-C03-B.choice_1: Filmer la comparaison avec la salle de bal
ENC-C03-B.log_1: Vous filmez l’annonce et le budget du club. Les donateurs de Trump achètent une salle de bal. Ceux du club peuvent pour l’instant se payer les mots « salle de bal ».
ENC-C03-B.log_2: Vous donnez des provisions et vous asseyez au calme. Le club donne votre nom au porte-serviettes. L’accès réservé aux donateurs est très abordable sans président dans le lot.
ENC-C03-B.fact: L’annonce de la Maison-Blanche de juillet 2025 présentait une salle de bal financée par Trump et des donateurs, en évoquant les tentes utilisées pour les grands événements. L’estimation initiale n’était pas un coût définitif ; la sécurité relevait séparément du Secret Service.

ENC-C03-C.name: Votre appel vous engage
ENC-C03-C.desc: Un tribunal a annulé la règle de la FTC sur la résiliation en un clic. Lors d’un repas partagé au bord de la route, une personne tente de résilier son abonnement à la salle de sport, téléphone sur haut-parleur. On vous invite à apporter de la nourriture ou à profiter de la salle tranquille. La musique d’attente a survécu à deux gratins.
ENC-C03-C.choice_0: Partager de la nourriture ; participer à l’exercice
ENC-C03-C.log_0: Vous partagez de la nourriture et encouragez la personne au téléphone. La salle de sport offre trois mois gratuits. Elle demande si l’un d’eux comprend le droit de partir.
ENC-C03-C.log_1: Avec son accord, vous enregistrez sa sélection de l’option résiliation. Une voix la félicite d’avoir choisi de rester membre. Pendant un instant, personne ne touche au téléphone.
ENC-C03-C.log_2: Vous donnez des provisions et vous installez dans la salle tranquille. Sa porte s’ouvre de l’intérieur. Vous envisagez de la recommander à la salle de sport.
ENC-C03-C.fact: En juillet 2025, la cour d’appel du huitième circuit a annulé la règle de la FTC sur la résiliation en un clic pour des raisons de procédure réglementaire. Cela ne rendait pas licite tout obstacle à la résiliation ; d’autres protections des consommateurs peuvent s’appliquer.

ENC-C05-A.name: Retour à l’expéditeur inexistant
ENC-C05-A.desc: À une bibliothèque, des bénévoles donnent à votre équipage des lettres sur les études inexistantes du premier rapport MAHA. On vous propose de la nourriture contre une réponse enregistrée exacte. Une personne retraitée de la poste a apporté une enveloppe vide. « Voilà toute la recherche qu’on a pu faire rentrer. »
ENC-C05-A.log_0: Vous lisez et conservez les lettres en riant. La personne retraitée a tellement souligné « adresse inconnue » que l’étude inexistante a désormais une fenêtre.
ENC-C05-A.log_1: Vous enregistrez les corrections des références et récupérez de la nourriture. La bibliothécaire vérifie que la réponse existe avant d’appuyer sur lecture.
ENC-C05-A.choice_2: Partager de la nourriture ; trier les lettres
ENC-C05-A.log_2: Vous partagez de la nourriture et triez les lettres avec les bénévoles. Chaque étude manquante reçoit un vrai trombone. Le budget de la science se redresse.
ENC-C05-A.fact: Des articles de mai 2025 ont relevé des études inexistantes et d’autres erreurs de références dans le premier rapport MAHA. Le HHS a déclaré avoir corrigé des erreurs de références et de mise en forme. Cela ne prouve ni que l’IA a causé ces erreurs ni que toutes les affirmations du rapport étaient fausses.

ENC-C05-B.name: Trop gros pour le formulaire
ENC-C05-B.desc: Une bénévole arrête votre van avec des lettres sur l’acceptation par le Pentagone du jet de luxe qatari. Son travail lui a imposé de déclarer un muffin reçu en cadeau. Elle propose de la nourriture contre une réponse enregistrée. Son formulaire demande si le muffin a des propriétaires étrangers.
ENC-C05-B.log_0: Vous conservez les lettres et riez de la déclaration du muffin. La bénévole lui a dessiné un train d’atterrissage. Le service conformité a refusé les roues supplémentaires.
ENC-C05-B.log_1: Vous enregistrez l’acceptation du jet et récupérez de la nourriture. Elle déclare elle-même les sandwichs. « Pas d’ailes. Ça devrait aller. »
ENC-C05-B.choice_2: Partager de la nourriture ; trier les lettres
ENC-C05-B.log_2: Vous partagez de la nourriture et aidez au tri. Quelqu’un plie le formulaire du muffin en avion. Son exemption pour les cadeaux s’améliore immédiatement.
ENC-C05-B.fact: Le 21 mai 2025, le Pentagone a annoncé avoir accepté un Boeing 747 du Qatar pour un usage présidentiel. Cette acceptation a soulevé des questions juridiques et éthiques ; elle n’établit ni une condamnation pour corruption ni une aptitude opérationnelle immédiate.

ENC-C05-C.name: Les autres convives
ENC-C05-C.desc: Après le dîner de Trump avec les principaux investisseurs de son meme coin, des habitués d’un restaurant ont rédigé leurs propres demandes d’audience. Ils arrêtent votre équipage pour les faire porter à Washington. La cuisine propose de la nourriture contre une réponse enregistrée. Leur invitation est agrafée à une facture de gaz impayée.
ENC-C05-C.log_0: Vous conservez les lettres en riant de la liste des invités. Profession : plonge. Portefeuille d’investissement : un gant contenant de quoi payer la laverie en pièces.
ENC-C05-C.log_1: Vous enregistrez leurs demandes et récupérez de la nourriture. En cuisine, on annonce la réception exclusive. C’est derrière le comptoir, à côté du balai.
ENC-C05-C.choice_2: Partager de la nourriture ; trier les demandes
ENC-C05-C.log_2: Vous partagez de la nourriture et triez les demandes. Les habitués portent un toast à votre arrivée avec de l’eau du robinet. Personne ne vérifie sa capitalisation boursière.
ENC-C05-C.fact: Le 22 mai 2025, Trump a reçu les principaux investisseurs de son meme coin dans son club de golf de Virginie ; environ 220 personnes étaient invitées. Cela relie investissement et accès, mais n’établit pas qu’un tribunal ait constaté l’achat de décisions politiques.

ENC-C06-A.name: L’échelle de couverture
ENC-C06-A.desc: Lors d’un atelier sur le financement de la santé, des bénévoles montrent à votre équipage comment la loi de 2025 modifie les dépenses et l’admissibilité à Medicaid. Une échelle sert de démonstration. Le barreau du bas porte l’étiquette « CONTRIBUABLE ». Le premier barreau accessible a été retiré pour que le modèle reste abordable.
ENC-C06-A.choice_0: Vérifier la loi et la démonstration
ENC-C06-A.log_0: Vous vérifiez les sources et comprenez les changements. Pour ranger, la bénévole remet le barreau manquant. Même la démonstration en a besoin pour fonctionner.
ENC-C06-A.log_1: Vous appréciez la répétition. La personne qui joue une sénatrice vante l’échelle depuis un escabeau apporté par quelqu’un d’autre.
ENC-C06-A.fact: La Public Law 119-21 réduit les dépenses fédérales Medicaid prévues et modifie les critères d’admissibilité. Les pertes de couverture annoncées sont des projections, pas des décomptes déjà observés. L’atelier et ses personnages sont fictifs.

ENC-C06-B.name: Le tarif par ministère
ENC-C06-B.desc: Washington a proposé aux agences fédérales l’IA Grok de Musk pour quarante-deux cents. À un salon de l’emploi au bord de la route, la personne qui anime l’atelier répète des entretiens avec un jouet parlant et vous invite à essayer. Elle demande si les salaires humains peuvent aussi couvrir un ministère entier.
ENC-C06-B.choice_0: Vérifier ce qu’achète réellement ce prix
ENC-C06-B.log_0: Vous expliquez le tarif d’accès par agence et gagnez en confiance et en compréhension. La colonne des salaires retrouve sa place. Le jouet reste disponible au prix de gros.
ENC-C06-B.log_1: Vous annoncez votre salaire par ministère entier. Le groupe rit ; la personne qui anime l’atelier reconnaît qu’une personne attend toujours une vraie fiche de paie.
ENC-C06-B.fact: Le 25 septembre 2025, la GSA a annoncé un accès à Grok à 0,42 dollar par organisation fédérale pour 18 mois, jusqu’en mars 2027. Il s’agissait d’une offre promotionnelle, ni d’un tarif permanent ni d’une capacité de calcul illimitée ; des fonctions et limites supérieures exigent une mise à niveau. L’entretien est fictif.

ENC-C06-C.name: Le titre secondaire
ENC-C06-C.desc: Trump a autorisé « département de la Guerre » comme titre secondaire. Dans une salle d’association d’anciens combattants, des bénévoles invitent votre équipage à examiner leur réponse : rebaptiser le toit qui fuit « Supériorité aérienne ». Un seau contrôle déjà l’espace en dessous.
ENC-C06-C.choice_0: Documenter la proposition et la fuite
ENC-C06-C.log_0: Vous vérifiez l’annonce du nouveau nom et documentez la réponse de l’association. La personne qui vous accueille vide le seau. La supériorité aérienne a atteint la moquette.
ENC-C06-C.choice_1: Participer à la répétition du baptême
ENC-C06-C.log_1: Vous appréciez la répétition. La personne bénévole baptise le balai « Dissuasion stratégique ». Une nouvelle goutte tombe pendant le salut.
ENC-C06-C.fact: La mesure de septembre 2025 a autorisé le titre secondaire de département de la Guerre. Elle n’a pas supprimé le nom légal de département de la Défense établi par le Congrès. La salle, les bénévoles et la proposition concernant le toit sont fictifs.

ALLY-01-A.name: Le parrainage de la casquette rouge
ALLY-01-A.desc: Votre contact extérieur {name} cesse de vous aider et rejoint une campagne de vente de produits MAGA. Son message d'adieu contient un code de réduction. La conversion politique a désormais son suivi d'affiliation.
ALLY-01-A.last: C'était votre dernier contact extérieur. Le groupe reste dans le fourgon ; votre réseau de soutien est désormais vide.

ALLY-02-A.name: L'efficacité est arrivée
ALLY-02-A.desc: Les coupes de DOGE coûtent son emploi à votre contact extérieur {name}, qui se retire pour chercher du travail. Sa dernière mission était de documenter la valeur du travail consistant à documenter sa valeur.
ALLY-02-A.last: C'était votre dernier contact extérieur. Le groupe reste dans le fourgon ; votre réseau de soutien est désormais vide.

ALLY-02-C.name: Le poste du mérite
ALLY-02-C.desc: Votre contact {name} perd son emploi quand une entreprise sous contrat supprime ses activités de diversité, d'équité et d'inclusion, et doit se retirer. Le patron annonce une nouvelle ère du mérite. Son fils annonce que le déjeuner est prêt.
ALLY-02-C.last: Votre dernier soutien extérieur s'est retiré. Les personnes encore en voyage devront continuer sans ce réseau.

ALLY-03-B.name: Les heures sup ruissellent
ALLY-03-B.desc: Votre contact {name} a besoin d'heures supplémentaires pour payer des factures médicales et se retire. Le Congrès vend les coupes du budget de la santé comme des économies. Votre contact aimerait savoir sur quel compte elles sont versées.
ALLY-03-B.last: Il ne reste aucun allié extérieur. Personne n'a quitté le fourgon à cause de ce message.

ALLY-03-C.name: Le budget alimentaire
ALLY-03-C.desc: Votre contact {name} accepte un service de plus pour payer les courses et cesse de vous aider. Le Congrès a vendu les coupes dans l'aide alimentaire comme de l'indépendance. Désormais, votre contact travaille le samedi en toute indépendance.
ALLY-03-C.last: Votre dernier soutien extérieur s'est retiré. Les personnes encore en voyage devront continuer sans ce réseau.

ALLY-04-B.name: La politique de retour patriotique
ALLY-04-B.desc: Votre contact {name} cesse de vous aider pour vendre des souvenirs du golfe d'Amérique. L'ancien stock du golfe du Mexique reste dessous. L'océan n'a pas encore demandé de remboursement.
ALLY-04-B.last: Il ne reste aucun allié extérieur. Personne n'a quitté le fourgon à cause de ce message.

ALLY-05-A.name: La discussion de l'État profond
ALLY-05-A.desc: Votre contact {name} envoie une vidéo affirmant que les journalistes ont inventé le scandale Signal, puis bloque le groupe. L'explication est désormais mieux sécurisée que la discussion sur les bombardements.
ALLY-05-A.last: C'était votre dernier contact extérieur. Le groupe reste dans le fourgon ; votre réseau de soutien est désormais vide.

ALLY-05-B.name: L'estomac classifié
ALLY-05-B.desc: Votre contact {name} décide que vos critiques du lait MAHA prouvent que vous travaillez pour la FDA et coupe le contact. Votre nouvelle carrière fédérale ne comprend aucun salaire, mais plusieurs crampes d'estomac.
ALLY-05-B.last: Il ne reste aucun allié extérieur. Personne n'a quitté le fourgon à cause de ce message.

ENC-C14-A.overlay_0: LIBÉRÉS DES RÈGLES LOCALES SUR LA CHALEUR

ENC-C02-A.name: Soutenir le dîner
ENC-C02-A.desc: Dans une banque alimentaire qui se prépare aux coupes de 2025 dans SNAP, les bénévoles accueillent votre équipe affamée et toute aide possible. Un tract sénatorial sur les baisses d’impôts cale le pied trop court d’une table. Il soutient enfin un repas.
ENC-C02-A.log_0: Vous mangez et emportez des provisions. Le tract reste sous la table : le retirer coûterait leur déjeuner à tout le monde.
ENC-C02-A.log_1: Vous recueillez leur témoignage et des provisions. Ils vous demandent de mentionner le gratin avant que Washington ne le classe parmi les dépenses inutiles.
ENC-C02-A.log_2: Vous donnez de la nourriture. Une bénévole colle votre reçu sur le sourire du sénateur. Enfin quelque chose sur ce tract qui ait nourri quelqu’un.
ENC-C02-A.fact: La loi de réconciliation budgétaire de 2025 prévoit des réductions des dépenses de SNAP et des changements d’admissibilité, ainsi que des dispositions fiscales. Elle ne permet pas d’affirmer que toutes les banques alimentaires ont perdu leur financement.

ENC-C02-B.name: Justificatif de déjeuner
ENC-C02-B.desc: Votre équipe est accueillie à un repas pour des travailleurs qui tentent de comprendre les exigences d’emploi élargies de SNAP. Les justificatifs d’une agente d’entretien occupent la seule chaise qu’elle n’a pas nettoyée. Les bénévoles recueillent leurs témoignages pour Washington.
ENC-C02-B.log_0: Vous mangez et prenez des provisions. L’agente d’entretien glisse ses fiches de paie sous une assiette. Pour une fois, elles l’aident à garder un repas.
ENC-C02-B.log_1: Vous recueillez son témoignage et prenez des provisions. Elle chronomètre l’entretien. Expliquer qu’elle travaille devient un deuxième emploi.
ENC-C02-B.log_2: Vous ajoutez de la nourriture au repas. Les bénévoles notent le don sur une ligne ; personne ne demande à votre responsable de confirmer que vous teniez la boîte.
ENC-C02-B.fact: La loi de réconciliation budgétaire de 2025 élargit les exigences de SNAP et crée des obligations d’activité pour Medicaid. Le déploiement fédéral de ces obligations pour Medicaid commence en janvier 2027, avec la possibilité pour les États de commencer plus tôt ; il ne s’agit pas d’une application nationale en 2026.

ENC-C02-C.name: Discours en sauce
ENC-C02-C.desc: Une cuisine près de l’autoroute nourrit les voyageurs avec les restes d’un dîner de donateurs d’un super PAC. Votre équipe affamée peut manger ou aider. L’invitation promettait une expression politique illimitée. Elle était surtout composée de steak.
ENC-C02-C.log_0: Vous mangez et prenez des provisions. Un steak rencontre enfin quelqu’un qui n’a pas payé de droit d’entrée pour exercer un droit constitutionnel.
ENC-C02-C.log_1: Vous documentez les restes et prenez des provisions. Les cuisinières ont débarrassé en trois minutes ce que les donateurs ont passé quatre heures à appeler de la libre expression.
ENC-C02-C.log_2: Vous donnez de la nourriture. La cuisinière la verse dans la marmite sans vérifier la puissance vocale de votre compte bancaire.
ENC-C02-C.fact: Les décisions Citizens United et SpeechNow fondent les dépenses indépendantes illimitées et les contributions illimitées aux comités qui ne font que de telles dépenses. Les plafonds des contributions directes aux candidats relèvent d’une autre règle.

ENC-C04-A.name: Contact avec le sol
ENC-C04-A.desc: Selon la NASA, Athena s’est posée sur le flanc, empêchant sa foreuse d’atteindre le sol lunaire. Lors d’un pique-nique astronomique au bord de la route, des bénévoles cherchent de l’aide pour leur maquette d’atterrisseur. Sa foreuse a déjà terminé la phase de contact avec le sol.
ENC-C04-A.log_0: Vous tirez la plateforme jusqu’à en avoir mal aux épaules. Le groupe applaudit son atterrissage réussi à l’autre bout de la table.
ENC-C04-A.choice_1: Donner du matériel pour la maquette
ENC-C04-A.log_1: Vos provisions stabilisent la plateforme et vous valent le soutien des bénévoles. Leur procédure d’approvisionnement prévoit désormais de vérifier où se trouve le haut.
ENC-C04-A.choice_2: Consigner le résultat réel de la mission
ENC-C04-A.log_2: Vous consignez l’échec de la foreuse et les données transmises par les autres instruments. Le bénévole abandonne une plaisanterie catastrophiste beaucoup plus simple, mais moins exacte.
ENC-C04-A.fact: La documentation de la NASA sur la charge utile d’Athena indique que l’orientation presque horizontale de l’atterrisseur a empêché la foreuse TRIDENT d’atteindre le sol lunaire et de remplir ses objectifs. Cette mission commerciale était sans équipage ; d’autres instruments ont transmis des données.

ENC-C04-B.name: Adjectifs made in USA
ENC-C04-B.desc: La FTC a accusé des vendeurs d’articles patriotiques de fausses allégations de fabrication américaine et proposé un accord. Dans une quincaillerie, une employée répare un support de drapeau retourné et accueille aide ou matériel. La publicité était entièrement américaine. Certains composants auraient fait un plus long voyage.
ENC-C04-B.choice_0: Aider à déplacer les éléments du support
ENC-C04-B.log_0: Vous déplacez les éléments jusqu’à en avoir mal aux épaules, en bonne compagnie. Le drapeau a davantage besoin d’une base solide que d’un adjectif supplémentaire.
ENC-C04-B.log_1: Votre matériel stabilise le support et inspire confiance. L’employée en note la provenance réelle : une approche étonnamment radicale de la description des produits.
ENC-C04-B.choice_2: Consigner la nuance sur la provenance
ENC-C04-B.log_2: Vous consignez fidèlement l’accusation et l’accord proposé. L’employée retire une affirmation non étayée sans devoir baisser le drapeau.
ENC-C04-B.fact: En avril 2026, la FTC a annoncé une plainte et un accord proposé concernant de fausses allégations d’origine américaine pour des supports de drapeaux. L’annonce présentait des accusations et une ordonnance soumise à l’approbation d’un tribunal, sans conclure que tous les articles patriotiques étaient importés.

ENC-C04-C.name: Libérés de l’ombre
ENC-C04-C.desc: Lors d’une foire itinérante de travailleurs, des couvreurs de Floride montrent à votre équipe la loi qui bloque les protections locales contre la chaleur. Leur auvent de protestation couvre la réserve d’eau. Un sponsor vantant la déréglementation y a installé sa chaise. Les couvreurs cherchent de l’aide pour déplacer le dispositif.
ENC-C04-C.log_0: Vous déplacez l’auvent jusqu’à en avoir mal aux bras. Les couvreurs rient en voyant le sponsor suivre son ombre sans jamais soutenir la mesure.
ENC-C04-C.log_1: Vous donnez de l’eau ; les couvreurs notent votre aide. Le sponsor affirme que s’hydrater relève de la responsabilité individuelle, puis demande à qui appartient la réserve d’eau.
ENC-C04-C.log_2: Vous enregistrez leur explication de la loi floridienne. Le sponsor continue de se glisser dans le cadre, précisément dans sa partie ombragée.
ENC-C04-C.fact: Une loi floridienne de 2024 interdit aux collectivités locales d’imposer certaines protections contre la chaleur au travail et certaines pauses pour boire. Elle n’interdit pas de boire de l’eau et ne supprime pas toutes les obligations fédérales.
ENC-C04-C.overlay_0: PROTECTIONS LOCALES CONTRE LA CHALEUR BLOQUÉES

play.travel_help: Set your pace and information diet, then travel. The road runs briefly before stopping at your next decision. Watch the gauges; choices and repairs report their actual costs.
play.outfit_help: Your starting funds pay for the selected cart. There are no free supplies underneath it. Add or remove food, water, parts and protection; you may leave empty. Purchases are charged when you depart. A spare is consumed only when fitted.
play.resupply_help: Choose supplies, parts and protection, then review the total. Buying charges your cash immediately and returns you to town. Leaving the store does not charge you. A spare is consumed only when fitted.
play.review_help: Check what you are carrying and what you will have left. These purchases happen when you start the journey.
play.capacity: Supplies are capped at 20. Extra provisions above that limit do not carry over.
play.pack_empty: A starter load is selected. Every item comes out of your funds—change or remove anything.
play.fuel_food_help: Food and water add supplies. Water also gives you a water-jug equipment tag.
play.vehicle_help: One matching spare is consumed when fitted. Without one, repairs may cost cash, time, or vehicle condition.
play.ppe_help: Protective gear softens specific weather penalties. Select an item to see what it protects against.
play.docs_help: A press pass can help at permit checks. A legal fund adds credibility.
play.pace_help: Steady adds no pace fatigue. Heated costs 1 Sanity and Blitz costs 2 per 5 hours of driving; unfinished fatigue carries into later drives. Weather and vehicle condition affect distance, and activities use available driving time.
play.diet_help: Your information diet is your news intake. Its Sanity effect applies once per day. Quieter coverage supports Sanity; doomscrolling improves your chances of finding receipts but costs Sanity.
play.locked: Les réglages du jour sont verrouillés jusqu’au lendemain.
play.weather_help: These modifiers describe the current weather. Conditions can change as the next day begins. Protective gear can replace some penalties.
play.cred_help: Credibility rises by listening to locals, documenting events and useful encounter choices. Misleading claims and some shortcuts reduce it. It affects the final hearing.
play.morale_help: Morale is the crew’s shared spirit. Care, rest, cooperation and successful encounters raise it. Losses, departures, hunger and difficult choices lower it.
play.sanity_help: News intake, rushed travel, illness and stressful choices can lower sanity. Quiet news, camp recovery and helpful encounters restore it. A warning appears at 2 or less.
play.health_help: Health falls through injury, hunger and hard physical work. Care, recovery days and some encounters restore it. At zero the journey ends.
play.supplies_help: Food and water share a 20-unit capacity. Travel, weather, care and barter use supplies. Buy provisions, gather outside town, trade or work for food to replenish them.
play.allies_help: Allies are outside supporters, separate from the people in your van. Helpful encounter choices build support; choices that spend or alienate support reduce it. Allies contribute to the final hearing.
play.travel_wait: Watch the road. Your next decision is approaching.
play.travel_done: You made it through this stretch.
play.journal_empty: The journal fills as your journey unfolds.
play.repair_help: Choose a repair and review its cost before fitting a part or calling for help.
play.danger: Sanity is in the danger zone
play.danger_help: Your sanity is 2 or lower. Consider rest or a quieter information diet before pushing on.
play.unknown_log: Trail conditions changed. Check the latest resource receipt.
play.seed_hint: Use a run code to replay a journey. Leave the generated code as-is for this trip.
play.receipts_help: Les preuves sont des documents pour ton audience à D.C. Obtiens-les avec les choix indiquant Preuves +1. Chaque preuve conservée ajoute 8 points au score du voyage. Leur nombre baisse uniquement lorsqu’un choix annonce en dépenser une.

play_log.jury: An improvised repair got you moving at a cost to vehicle condition.
play_log.blocked: Travel is blocked by a breakdown.
play_log.service: Roadside service was arranged. See the cash and condition changes.
play_log.field: A field repair kept the vehicle moving.
play_log.partial: You made progress along the route.

journey.forecast_caveat: La météo, les soins et vos choix peuvent modifier cette estimation.
journey.forecast_stable: Recent completed travel days did not reduce supply stock. Keep a reserve for weather, care and delays.

journey.camp_forecast: These are the recovery effects at your current levels. One stationary day passes; weather and hunger can also affect the crew. Rest helps every present crew member.
journey.capacity: The van holds 20 supply units. Remove surplus packs before checkout; you will not be charged for goods you cannot carry.
journey.shop_help: Restock for the next leg. Your current supplies and spares are already in the van.
journey.rolling: On the road. Travel continues until a decision, arrival or danger needs you.
journey.arrival_help: The road can wait. Restock, exchange goods or hear what the locals know before departing.
journey.town_heartland: The grain elevator has been renamed the Center for Agricultural Innovation. It still buys grain. Neighbors recommend a spare tire for the rural stretch ahead; volunteers run the aid table. Your notes add credibility.
journey.town_rustbelt: The old mill is an Innovation District now. The library still has working outlets. Locals recommend a spare battery; the exchange board lists today’s offer. You record their account.
journey.town_beltway: The community center is accepting feedback about the feedback process. Neighbors point out the actual aid desk around the back. Gather your evidence and rest before the D.C. hearing.
journey.care_body: The medic offers {name} treatment before asking about payment. You briefly suspect an elaborate sting.
journey.care_critical: {name} is critically ill. Continuing without care will kill them. Provide care or take a full recovery day.
journey.shelter_action: Leave a companion with the medics · Crew member leaves · {effects}
journey.defer_action: Keep driving without care · {effects} · Illness may worsen
journey.care_hint: Each choice takes one hour. Care costs two supplies. Only companions can leave with the medics. A full recovery day clears illness.
journey.care_helped: {name} is fit to travel. Two supplies: the least insulting medical bill in America.
journey.care_sheltered: {name} stays for care. The health system works; the carpool doesn’t.
journey.care_deferred: {name} is still sick. You’ve recreated your old job’s sick-leave policy: keep going.
journey.care_lost: {name} dies. The crew continues without them.
journey.mission: Bring the crew and evidence of institutional nonsense to a public hearing in D.C. Gather receipts, build credibility and find allies along the way. Arriving is only part of it: the crew needs enough sanity to be heard.
journey.multiplier: Affects final scoring, not your travel speed or starting cash.
journey.vote_exhausted: The crew cannot withstand the full hearing at these levels. Recover before proceeding.
journey.vote_chance: Estimated chance of passing the final vote: {chance}%.
journey.vote_basis: Evidence, credibility, allies, health, morale and supplies contribute to the journey score. Days and resolved encounters add experience; breakdowns subtract from it. The crew needs enough sanity to complete the hearing. The final vote is uncertain.
journey.vote_won: The hearing passed. Your crew’s account is on the record in D.C.
journey.vote_lost: The hearing ended without a win. The journey and the people who helped still count.
journey.forecast: Recent supply use: about {days} days of stock. Conditions and choices can change this.
journey.forecast_wait: Supply outlook appears after the first travel day. Carry a reserve for weather, care and delays.
journey.abandon_explanation: This ends the current journey and saves its story. You can start a new trip or load a separate manual save.
journey.abandoned_story: {name} chose to end the trail here with {crew}. Your journey and everyone who traveled with you remain in the journal.

trail.repair_radio: Call local radio; work in exchange for repairs

trail.repaired: The {part} is fitted. The crew checks the van before continuing.
trail.gather_help: Outside town, gather once every three completed days. Choose a short forage or harder work with more food. In towns, choose one paid or food-for-work offer per stop. Supplies cannot exceed 20; unavailable choices show their costs before you commit.
trail.work_supplies: Sort donations for a food parcel
trail.forage_done: Your guide identifies what can be gathered safely. The crew returns with food and a clearer head.
trail.glean_done: The farmer shares the harvest. Lifting and carrying have taken a physical toll.
trail.work_supplies_done: The donation shelves are stocked and the crew receives an agreed food parcel.
trail.work_cash_done: The unloading shift is complete. Payment goes directly into the crew’s cash reserve.
trail.gather_wait: Gathering available again in {days} travel days.
trail.work_done: You have completed this stop’s work offer. More offers await in the next town.
trail.fact_note: Local facts are sourced. The resident and their commentary are fictional.
trail.care_reason_0: {name} feels sick after a MAHA raw-milk sample. The vendor blames the deep state inside their stomach.
trail.care_reason_1: {name} is dehydrated. The unloading boss crossed out the heat warning with a Sharpie. Apparently the sun doesn’t take corrections.
trail.care_reason_2: {name} stayed up listing five accomplishments for a DOGE-inspired boss. Exhausted, they submit a sixth: unpaid overtime.
trail.care_reason_3: {name} vomits after a MAHA wellness sample. The vendor cites ‘unpublished research.’ They publish a rebuttal into his sample bucket.
trail.care_reason_4: {name} lost sleep navigating a road with three patriotic names. None of them was the exit you needed.
trail.care_reason_5: {name} spent the night disputing a repair tariff. They’re exhausted. The trade war has secured a decisive victory over bedtime.
trail.care_reason_6: {name} is exhausted from a temp-job Signal chat. The boss added strangers, leaked the door code, and took inspiration from the cabinet.
trail.care_reason_7: {name} strains their back hauling donated food after USDA delivery cuts. Washington has replaced a delivery budget with their spine.
trail.satire_note: La scène, les dialogues et les prix sont une satire fictive inspirée de cet épisode documenté.
